direction: a Responses-API client (Codex-derived) driving a chat-completions server (llama.cpp and most OpenAI-compatible servers)
why_first: A translation layer is judged by what it preserves. Written after the code, a conformance suite tends to describe what the code already does; written first, it describes what the code must do, and the difference shows up exactly where the translation is lossy.

epistemic_basis.wire_api_selection: VERIFIED 2026-09-16 from codex-rs/model-provider-info/src/lib.rs. Codex has one WireApi variant, Responses; wire_api = "chat" is a hard error. See ADR-0002.
epistemic_basis.payload_field_spellings: WORKING_ASSUMPTION. The Codex archive is no longer present in this environment, so the exact field names below were not re-derived from source in this pass. They follow the documented Responses and chat-completions surfaces. Every invariant is stated in terms of what must survive rather than what it is called, so a corrected spelling changes the vectors and not the contract -- but the vectors must be re-checked against the archive before any shim is written against them.
epistemic_basis.restated: Nothing here is claimed as VERIFIED that was not measured. A vector that encodes a guessed field name is still a real test of the invariant it carries; it is not evidence about the wire.

invariants.name: instructions survive
invariants.requires: A top-level `instructions` string reaches the server as a system message, first, unaltered.
invariants.failure_if_violated: The system prompt is silently dropped. The model answers without its constraints and the answer looks normal.

invariants.name: tool declarations survive exactly
invariants.requires: Each declared tool keeps its name, description and parameter schema byte-for-byte through the shape change from flat to nested.
invariants.failure_if_violated: A subtly altered parameter schema makes the model emit arguments the caller cannot parse, or worse, can.

invariants.name: a tool call survives with identical arguments
invariants.requires: call_id, name and the arguments string round-trip unchanged. Arguments are carried as an opaque string and never re-serialised.
invariants.failure_if_violated: Re-serialising JSON can reorder keys or renormalise numbers. The call still parses and is no longer the call the model made.

invariants.name: a tool result rejoins its call
invariants.requires: A function_call_output reaches the server as a tool message carrying the same call_id.
invariants.failure_if_violated: The result is attributed to the wrong call, or to none, and the model reasons from an answer to a question it did not ask.

invariants.name: reasoning is never silently dropped
invariants.requires: Chat-completions has no reasoning item. Reasoning content must either survive in a named, labelled form or make the translation refuse -- and either way the caller is told, by a translation note.
invariants.failure_if_violated: The single highest-value case for a local reasoning model degrades invisibly. Nothing errors; the answers just get worse.

invariants.name: a truncated completion never reads as complete
invariants.requires: finish_reason `length` becomes status `incomplete` with a stated reason, never `completed`.
invariants.failure_if_violated: This is receipt-is-not-postcondition in the transport layer: a cut-off answer presented as a finished one.

invariants.name: usage is reported, never invented
invariants.requires: Token counts are renamed, not computed. A server that reports no usage produces a translation with no usage, not zeros.
invariants.failure_if_violated: Zero-valued counts are indistinguishable from measured ones, and a resource ledger built on them budgets against fiction.

invariants.name: streamed text concatenates to the whole answer
invariants.requires: Concatenating every text delta yields exactly the text a non-streamed response would carry.
invariants.failure_if_violated: A dropped or reordered delta produces an answer that is wrong in a way no status field reports.

invariants.name: streamed tool arguments concatenate to the same string
invariants.requires: Argument fragments concatenate to the identical arguments string, and are emitted under the call they belong to.
invariants.failure_if_violated: Interleaved parallel tool calls merge into one malformed argument blob.

invariants.name: an unknown field is refused, not dropped
invariants.requires: A request carrying a field the translator does not understand is refused. It is never forwarded minus the field.
invariants.failure_if_violated: A future Responses field that constrains behaviour -- a safety setting, a cache key, a seed -- is quietly discarded and the request means something else.

not_covered: Transport. No HTTP server, no SSE framing, no backpressure, no connection handling, no error mapping. This contract is about the meaning of the bytes, not about moving them.
Provider quirks. Real servers deviate from the documented shapes, and those deviations are discovered by running against them, not by reasoning about them here.
Authentication, retries, timeouts and rate limits.
